narrative: A bill nailed to the post by the Theatre door. Two lines, black on pale paper. No author's name. October light, grey and thin. No face. The second line. No part is listed. No price is written under it. His hand is not in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the two lines and did not add a third.

entities.name: The Two Gentlemen of Verona
entities.context: Shown on bill in Read Two Gentlemen of Verona on the bill
